product_family: Amazon Q Developer - a generative AI coding assistant for developers with capabilities in IDEs (JetBrains, VS Code, Visual Studio, Eclipse), CLI, AWS Management Console, and chat applications (Teams, Slack, GitHub). Successor to Fig command-line tool, which AWS acquired in August 2023 and integrated into Amazon Q Developer.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1/2/3
certifications.proof_quote: Amazon Q Developer is included in the latest SOC 1/2/3 reports. Customers can download third-party audit reports using AWS Artifact.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: AWS maintains ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification. As Amazon Q Developer runs on AWS infrastructure and benefits from AWS security controls, ISO 27001 applies at the platform level, though Amazon Q Developer's specific service scope status should be confirmed with AWS.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliant
certifications.proof_quote: AWS has incorporated GDPR Data Processing Agreement terms into the AWS Service Terms, which automatically apply to customers whose activities come within GDPR scope.

certifications.name: HIPAA BAA
certifications.proof_quote: Amazon Q Developer is not designed to transmit, store, or process ePHI (electronic protected health information). Customers must ensure Amazon Q Developer is never used with ePHI data. Only Amazon Q Business offers HIPAA compliance.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management)
certifications.proof_quote: Amazon Q Business is compliant with ISO/IEC 42001, but this certification is not explicitly confirmed for Amazon Q Developer.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: AWS maintains PCI DSS compliance certification at the infrastructure level. AWS services including Amazon Q, when properly configured, can support PCI DSS compliance requirements.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: AWS maintains FedRAMP certification for AWS GovCloud regions. Amazon Q is accessible through AWS infrastructure that includes FedRAMP certified services.

privacy.ai_training_note: Amazon Q Developer Free Tier: AWS may use questions, responses, and generated code for service improvement, debugging, and model training. Users can opt out via AWS Organizations AI services opt-out policy or IDE settings. Amazon Q Developer Pro: AWS does NOT use content for service improvement. Data usage policies differ significantly by pricing tier.
privacy.data_region: Multiple AWS regions; customers can choose region for data residency

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 or later required; TLS protocol used for all data transmission

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AWS encryption solutions and default security controls within AWS services; FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic modules available

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Enterprise-grade access controls via AWS IAM; respects AWS IAM Identity Center governance, identities, roles, and permissions

security.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
security.value: MFA support via AWS IAM for account access

security.name: Audit Logging
security.value: API and user activity logging via AWS CloudTrail

products.name: Amazon Q Developer - IDE Integration
products.data_scope: User code, questions, generated code suggestions. For Free Tier: may be used for service improvement and model training. For Pro: not used for service improvement.
products.notes: Available in JetBrains, IntelliJ IDEA, Visual Studio, VS Code, Eclipse; inline code suggestions and vulnerability scanning

products.name: Amazon Q Developer - CLI
products.data_scope: CLI commands and responses; subject to same data usage policies as IDE
products.notes: Successor to Fig Desktop command-line tool; autocompletion and AI assistance in terminal

products.name: Amazon Q Developer - AWS Console
products.data_scope: AWS resource queries and responses; respects AWS IAM permissions
products.notes: Available in AWS Management Console and AWS Console Mobile Application

products.name: Amazon Q Developer - Chat Applications
products.data_scope: Chat interactions in Teams and Slack; subject to service improvement policies
products.notes: Integrations with Microsoft Teams and Slack for operational monitoring and AWS troubleshooting

products.name: Amazon Q Developer - GitHub Integration (Preview)
products.data_scope: GitHub code and pull requests; currently does NOT use content for service improvement
products.notes: Feature implementation, code review, Java transformation; AWS will provide notice before enabling data usage

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Free Tier with limits (50 agentic interactions/month, 1000 lines code transformation/month); Pro Tier at $19/month per user
compare.data_residency: AWS regions (customer-selectable); AWS maintains data centers globally

flags: 'Fig (Amazon Q)' refers to Fig Desktop, which Amazon acquired in August 2023 and integrated into Amazon Q Developer; Fig as a standalone product sunset on September 1, 2024. This report covers Amazon Q Developer, the successor product.

SOC 2 Type 1/2/3 and PCI DSS certifications apply to the AWS platform overall; AWS asserts that Amazon Q Developer is included at the service level, but customers should confirm this via AWS Artifact using the most recent audit reports.
Amazon Q Developer is explicitly not suitable for HIPAA use cases; only Amazon Q Business, a separate product, offers a HIPAA BAA. This is a material difference between the two products.

The Free Tier and Pro Tier have dramatically different data usage policies: Free Tier data is used for model training unless you explicitly opt out, while Pro Tier data is not used for service improvement. This is a critical distinction for compliance-sensitive customers.

AWS offers a global DPA and GDPR compliance, but responsibility is shared: customers must configure Amazon Q appropriately to ensure GDPR compliance for their use case, including keeping sensitive personal data out of prompts.

While Amazon Q Business has ISO 42001 (AI governance) certification, Amazon Q Developer's scope for this certification is not explicitly documented; given it is an AI service, confirm ISO 42001 coverage with AWS.
The data usage policy for the Amazon Q Developer integration in GitHub, currently in preview, may change in future versions; AWS has committed to providing notice.

Amazon Q Developer's compliance posture benefits from AWS's infrastructure certifications, but those inherited platform certifications should be distinguished from dedicated service-level certifications.
